title.ko: 개인정보처리자가 개인정보 처리 기준 및 보호조치 등에 관하여 자율적으로 개인정보 처리방침에 포함하여 정한 사항

rules.statement: Describe protection measures taken voluntarily beyond statutory safety duties.

AI model/system developers and AI service providers should set and publish criteria for collecting, preprocessing and using training data (main sources, collection methods, minimum quality standards, safety measures), reflecting data minimization and purpose specification.
Any certification, assessment or activity claimed must be confirmed by the interview (scope and period stated).

additionalProtection: domestic/overseas certifications such as ISMS-P (with scope and period)
privacy by design and privacy impact assessment
transparency: AI training-data collection and use criteria
privacy posts on blogs or video platforms
userLiteracy: app permission management and consent withdrawal

goodPatterns: Lead sentence on extra effort beyond statutory duties; certification table (name, scope, period); voluntary PIA statement with system and period; one line for other activities.

commonDefects.defect: Claims a certification the company does not hold or with wrong scope (accuracy).
Gen-AI service with no published training-data criteria (recommended).
